content.short: Conduit lets you launch your own production-ready OP Stack rollup in minutes on the only self-serve RaaS platform.
content.description: Conduit is a crypto-native infrastructure platform that focuses on making rollups-ready deployments fast and reliable. The initial offering lets you deploy production-grade OP Stack rollups on Ethereum in minutes with zero operations required on your side. The platform takes care of scalability, reliability, and upgrades, freeing you to focus on building applications. Each deployment includes logs, monitoring, a Blockscout explorer, and samczsun's transaction tracer, plus automatic access to new components as upgrades ship.
